title: Ensemble Multi-Relational Graph Neural Networks
operation: Alternately optimize global per-relation simplex coefficients using node-representation smoothness, and propagate one representation with their weighted normalized adjacencies plus restart to original features. Decoupled feature MLP and one classifier trained with cross entropy.
relationship_to_GNNM: The word ensemble denotes combination of relation-specific graph operators in one propagated predictor; the inspected method does not train or average four independent/shared classifier members.
prior_boundary: Learned relation mixture, decoupled propagation, restart and efficient relation coefficients are established. Member-specific graph-evidence weighting alone is not cleared as novel.
possible_control_role: Competent relation-mixture architecture control if exploring new heterogeneous or multi-relational tasks, after native recipe/source qualification. Not a plug-in equal-budget predictor-ensemble comparator.
limitations: No author implementation, appendix algorithm, complete proofs or visual figures read
Ten-run fixed-split recipe is reported but not reproduced
MUTAG here is a relational node-classification graph; do not conflate it with graph-level MUTAG molecular classification
No numerical result adopted, broader novelty search or empirical advantage established
